examples.name: Don't Get Liquidated
examples.pitch: Borrow against your ETH, then survive a price drop. Players learn health factor and liquidation by feeling it.

examples.name: Beat the Slippage
examples.pitch: Pick a slippage setting before the market moves. Players learn why trades fail or get front-run.

examples.name: Bridge Puzzle
examples.pitch: Put the bridge steps in the right order, starting with checking you are on the real site. Players learn to bridge safely.

faq.a: About 1, 2 or 3 weeks by tier, from the call.

faq.q: What do you need from us?
faq.a: Logo, colours, the one thing players should learn, and a contact for questions.
Two rounds included. Bigger changes are quoted first.
Embed and share it freely. We host it and keep the code, so it stays fast and safe.
Merch or product perks, yes. Never tokens, and nothing that promises returns.

faq.q: Do you build for any project?
faq.a: No. Every project is vetted first. Declined? Full deposit refund.
